name: dialog

files.content:
{#if ctx.open}
{@render ctx.content?.()}
{/if} {@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { ContentProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: ContentProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// Hand the content to the root, which renders it inside the dialog.
	ctx.content = children;

	// Hand the classes and attributes to the root too, which puts them on the panel.
	$effect.pre(() => {
		ctx.contentClass = className;
		ctx.contentAttrs = props;
	});
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { TriggerProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, trigger, variant = "default", size, rounded, class: className }: TriggerProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const triggerProps = { onclick: () => (ctx.open = true) };
</script>

<!-- Render the custom trigger when given, otherwise a default button. -->
{#if trigger}
	{@render trigger({ props: triggerProps })}
{:else}
	<Button {variant} {size} {rounded} class={className} {...triggerProps}>{@render children?.()}</Button>
{/if}

description: A modal window built on the native dialog element, with a trigger and a content panel.
